g.aria-label: Concat CLS + four register tokens + patches
g.data-label: Concat CLS + four register tokens + patches
g.text: Concat CLS + four register tokens + patches
No DETR decoder or cross-attention module.
The shared encoder attends jointly to
queries, five prefix tokens and image patches.
Mask guidance before each final block
Other query/key pairs remain allowed. Masking is applied when attn_mask_probs for the block is positive.
Fresh configurations use ones. Checkpoint buffer values can disable this guidance; the encoder path stays present.
The next block consumes this mask and the current token state, then the prediction is recomputed.
The same heads serve mask guidance and the final predictions.
Postprocessing is outside the learned encoder and heads.
